column1: <bold>Summary:</bold> <italic><red>A man and a child have been killed</red> after a <red>light</red> aircraft made an emergency landing on a beach in Portugal.</italic>
<bold>Document:</bold> Authorities said the incident took place on Sao Joao beach in Caparica, south-west of Lisbon.
The National Maritime Authority said <red>a middle-aged man and a young girl died</red> after they were unable to avoid the plane.
[<italic>6 sentences with 139 words are abbreviated from here.</italic>]
Other reports said the victims had been sunbathing when the plane made its emergency landing.
[<italic>Another 4 sentences with 67 words are abbreviated from here.</italic>]
Video footage from the scene carried by local broadcasters showed <red>a small recreational plane</red> parked on the sand, apparently intact and surrounded by beachgoers and emergency workers.
